name: Sentry Kite
presence: Sentry Kite wears three coats and a rifle older than the ash. She has the tired authority of someone who still believes in doors.

presenceWhen.text: Kite keeps the rifle low. "Don't make me learn your name," she says, which is her version of mercy.

greeting: Clearance. One word. The radio on the antenna walk knows it, if they know how to listen. You know how to shoot.

password.gist: You do not give the word to people who ask for the word. That is the whole job. Tell them to listen to the tower.

ash.gist: The thing in the mast uses faces; they should not give it theirs for free. A lens helps. It also makes the radio speak in complete sentences.

relay.gist: East is the nest. Nobody goes east on charm.

say.gist: Clearance accepted; you lowered the rifle, tired of being correct. The nest is east. They must not sell her anything she asks to borrow.
That is a word, not a clearance. Tell them to come back when the tower has actually told them.

combat.onDeathSay: Kite goes down still trying to rack the old rifle. The roof is yours, and so is a small shame. East is unguarded.
